outcome: onset and duration of sensory and motor blockade
cohort: 100 ASA I-II patients undergoing elective caesarean section
finding: 0.5% Isobaric Levobupivacaine 10mg for intrathecal injection of caesarean section produces adequate sensory and motor blockade and stable hemodynamic parameters with minimum adverse effects than 0.5% Hyperbaric Bupivacaine 10mg.
